headline: North Queensland Homeowners Face Unaffordable Post-Flood Insurance
summary: Homeowners in north Queensland face severe difficulties obtaining or affording home insurance almost two years after regional flooding disasters.
why: Rising climate and natural disaster losses have driven sharp premium increases across Australia, challenging property market values and property-casualty insurer margins.

impacts.name: Australian Property Insurance
impacts.why: Severe premium inflation and risk re-evaluations reduce insurance uptake and strain household balance sheets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
